notes.title: 6/18 (Wed) Bug Fix Patch Notice
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Hunters. [b]Level Up the Action.[/b][/p][p]This is Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE team.[/p][p][/p][p]A patch is scheduled for 6/18 (Wed) to fix issues and improve service stability.[/p][p][/p][p]The matchmaking for multiplay mode may be unstable during the patch and you can enjoy the game with the new patch applied by logging back in once the patch is complete.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]📌 Patch Schedule[/b][/p][p]- 6/18 (Wed) 01:55 (UTC+0)[/p][p][/p][p][b]📌 Patch Details[/b][/p][p]- Fixed the issue where Sung Jinwoo would start moving from a standing position when holding the movement key on the first stage.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where changing the voice language to Japanese did not apply the correct voice lines.[/p][p]- Fixed the occasional issue where an "Easy Anti-Cheat not installed" error popup would appear when launching the game.  [/p][p]- Added a new “Accounts” tab in the in-game Options menu.[/p][p]* Added a button that leads to the Customer Support in the Options > Accounts.[/p][p]The submitted inquiries to the Customer Support will be used as a reference to provide a better service when releasing the official version.[/p][p]* The Customer Support button in the options can be seen after accessing the Lobby.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue in Dungeon Break where rewards were not granted after defeating certain monsters.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where the shortcut could be used on Design/Precision Design even when the "use" button was disabled.[/p][p]- Fixed the frame drop issue occurring under certain conditions.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where an error code was displayed when upgrading weapons.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where certain skill effects for Alicia Blanche were displayed abnormally.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where stat points were not distributed when selecting combat style.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where the stat points were reduced when resetting stats.[/p][p]* The stat points will be applied normally when restarting the game after the patch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]📌 Notes[/b][/p][p]* Please completely close and restart the game to apply the patch.[/p][p]* Certain content features may not be available while the patch is being applied.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/8ad6bab2b35eb331b601a4e9c182d22d29a3c53e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 6/10 (Tue) Bug Fix Patch Notice
notes.notes:
Greetings Hunters.[b]Level Up the Action.[/b]
This is Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE team.

A patch is scheduled for 6/10 (Tue) to fix issues and improve service stability.

You can enjoy the game with the new patch applied by logging back in once the patch is complete.

---

📌 [b]Schedule[/b]
- 6/10 (Tue) 5:20 (UTC+0)

📌 [b]Details[/b]
- To fix an issue where certain content cannot be progressed, and to stabilize the service

📌 [b]Notes[/b]
* Please completely close and restart the game to apply the patch.
* Certain content features may not be available while the patch is being applied.

---

Thank you.

notes.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Hunters. [b]Level Up the Action.[/b]
This is Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE team.

Pleased to meet you, Hunters!
A demo of Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE is now available.

While preparing the demo, we envisioned countless times the day we would finally meet you, Hunters — and now, we’re grateful that the day has come to share it with you.

We hope all our Hunters enjoy the game and we look forward to your support, interest, and valuable feedback. 

You can now download and play the game on Steam, and more details are provided below for Hunters.

[b]--- [/b]

📌 [b]Schedule[/b]
 - 6/9 (Mon) 16:00 (UTC+0)

📌 [b]Details[/b]
- Download and play the demo on Steam!

[b]\[How to Play the Demo][/b]
1. Visit the Steam website to download Steam
2. Launch Steam and log in to your account
3. Download and play Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE from the Steam Store page

📌 [b]Demo FAQ[/b]
1. Which platforms is the game available on?
▶ You can play the game through Steam.

2. What are the minimum and recommended system requirements for playing the game?
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Minimum System Requirements[/p][/th][th][p]Recommended System Requirements[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]CPU : i5 4460  [/p][p]Ram : 8GB  [/p][p]Graphic : Geforce GTX 1050  [/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][td][p]CPU : i5 9400  [/p][p]Ram : 16GB  [/p][p]Graphic : Geforce RTX 2060  [/p][p]OS : Window 10 or higher[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]3. Which languages are supported in the game?
▶ A total of 13 languages are supported in-game, with in-game voice available in Korean, and Japanese.

4. A bug/issue has been found in the game.
▶ We kindly ask for your understanding, as unexpected bugs or technical issues may occur in the demo version.
Due to the nature of the demo, it will be difficult to address the reported issues immediately. However, we will do our best to deliver a stable and polished game at launch.
We encourage you to join the Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Discord channel, where you can engage in active chats with other Hunters.
[b][url="https://discord.gg/sololevelingoverdrive"]\[Go to Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Discord][/url][/b]
* Please note that the Discord channel is operated only in English. 

5. A login failure pop-up is appearing when accessing the game.
▶ You may encounter this pop-up when accessing the game in Steam offline mode. Please launch the game in online mode instead. 

[b]---[/b]

Thank you.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010824/8ad6bab2b35eb331b601a4e9c182d22d29a3c53e.png"][/img][/p]
